Sample test assets used by pytest.

- `mono16_5x5.tiff`: 5x5 monochrome TIFF (`uint16`)
- `mono8_5x5.png`: 5x5 monochrome PNG (`uint8`)
- `color8_5x5.jpg`: 5x5 color JPG (`uint8`)
- `color16_5x5.tiff`: 5x5 color TIFF (`uint16`)
- `color32_5x5.fit`: 5x5 RGB FITS-like image (`float32`)
- `mono32_5x5.fit`: 5x5 monochrome FITS-like image (`float32`)
- `mono16_5x5.fit`: 5x5 monochrome FITS-like image (`uint16`)
